items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1959-11-17
items.q: That's like Kid Victor. I don't know his right name. Yeah. From Baton Rouge.

ctx.x: Say, who were some of the bands in Baton Rouge? Some of them, well, I didn't know now they got George Williams. You know him George Williams? And uh. Spider used to have a band there, didn't he? Who? Spider. Spider. Oh, Spider, he don't play no more. He was a good corner player, Spider. He don't play no more. Me and him was in Houston, Texas together. Yeah. Yeah, he don't play no more. No. Maybe they say he played a little bit of a job, but not much. Even his daddy used to play, you know. What is Spider's right…
That's like Kid Victor. I don't know his right name. Yeah. From Baton Rouge.

And all the rest of them fellas I know, they did. And you say, have a fella there that had a band that played trombone named Stuart. Stuart, yeah, yeah. And then they had a Stuart premiere, used to play trumpet. Yeah. He went up there, but I went up there and played with them a while, you know, until I got ready to come home. He had the Johnson band. Oh, yeah. Yeah.
